name: overseerr
title: Overseerr
description: Request page for a Plex server: people search for a film or a series, ask for it, and an approved request goes to Radarr or Sonarr. Open it after deploying and sign in with the Plex account that owns the server to finish the setup. The project is no longer developed and Seerr is its successor (there is a template for it); this one is for an existing Overseerr setup you want to keep.

variables.name: PORT_OVERSEERR
variables.label: Host Port
variables.description: Port to expose Overseerr on; the Seerr and Jellyseerr templates use numbers next to it, change one when two of them run on one server

auth_note: Not put behind Authelia: its own apps and clients sign in directly (the deploy sheet can still protect it)
